Name: (CP) (AT)  Nostalgic Old Furniture Collection
Author: StarDust0001
Description:
· · ────── ·𖥸· ────── · ·
[b]Introduction[/b]
Added some comfortable and vintage furniture to your game, everyone loves antiques, isn't? :)
The original purpose of the mod was to replace the original furniture, but after the 1.6 update, I made many adjustments and with the help of the new coding, I was finally able to complete it.
Due to my unfortunate time schedule, I have not played SDV1.6, but I have tried my best to test this mod. If there are still any bugs somewhere, tell me anyway.
I still want to add a lot of things, but for now I'll settle for what's already done and hope you'll enjoy them as well :D
[b]· · ────── ·𖥸· ────── · ·[/b]
[b]Feature
(FOR CP)
[/b]You can choose modes from Config or Generic Mod Config Menu.

[i]——Replace——[/i]
Replacing some original furniture.
I made some changes to the code, so you can use "China Cabinet" as a dresser.

[i]——Add——
[/i]All furniture are turned into new furniture, which you can find from family catalog or use CJB to obtain.
[quote]Known issue:
If this mode is turned off, all new furniture turn into error image.
TVs and fish tanks can't work.
Double bed can't be shared with spouse.[/quote]

[i]——Disable——[/i]
Yep, you can directly turn off this mod, isn't that beautiful?
[b]· · ────── ·𖥸· ────── · ·
Language[/b]
If you use replacement mode, then there is no need for translation.
But Add mode requires translation, as they become new furniture.

Curently it has English and Chinese texts. 目前中英兼容。

If you want to do a translation, you don't need to ask.
You can directly send it to me or publish it on Nexus, but please do not include my mod content.
[b]· · ────── ·𖥸· ────── · ·[/b]
